Why travel with us

Less travelled places, at a leisurely pace

Since our beginnings we have specialised in small group journeys to places that are different, sometimes a little off the beaten track, but always fascinating.

Small groups

An average of 4 to 12 travellers, for a stronger group spirit and the detours larger tours can't take.

Personal care

One tour consultant looks after you from your first enquiry right through to departure.

More time

Itineraries keep travelling time to a minimum, so there is room to explore and relax.

Good value

We include as much as we can, with no hidden costs or optional activities to budget for.

Plan your expedition

Tell us where you want to go

Share your destination and travel dates. A tour consultant will come back to you with availability and send your expedition manual.
